## Publish gate report

**Going out:** Landing hero copy, Pebblebrook Tea Co. (UK). No date or audience given beyond the channel.

### Claims check
| Claim | Status |
|---|---|
| "you'll love it or it's free" | **Blocked.** Policy section 3 lists this as a guarantee we don't offer. There is no such offer. |
| "Subscribers can pause or cancel any time" | On the policy list (subscription terms). OK. |
| "free UK delivery on orders over £25" | On the policy list (shipping policy). OK. |
| "most boxes ship free" | **Unproven.** The policy doesn't say what share of orders clear £25, so this is an implied statistic. Remove it. |

### Regulated claims
The guarantee is also a price/offer claim, so it needs the approver's attention. Nothing on health, environment or children.

### House style
No banned words. Voice is mostly warm and plain. The opening "easy to stop and start" is a little vague, and the sentence runs on with two ideas joined by "and". Score is roughly 75 before the fixes and 90 after.

### Disclosure
This is our own landing page, so no ad or partnership label is needed.

### Suggested rewrite
> Tea that's easy to stop and start. Subscribers can pause or cancel any time, and delivery is free in the UK on orders over £25.

### Fixed (in the suggested copy)
- Removed "you'll love it or it's free" (invented guarantee).
- Removed "most boxes ship free" (unsupported implied stat), and restated the delivery offer exactly as the policy words it.
- Split the run-on sentence.

### Needs a decision
- Nothing unresolved if you accept the rewrite. If the team really wants a satisfaction guarantee, it has to become a real offer in the policy first.

### Approver
Sam (marketing lead). I haven't recorded any approval, and the original draft is not approved. Sam needs to give an explicit yes to the rewritten text, and it should be re-checked if anything changes after that.
